title: Block Highlighter
description: This mod adds ability to highlight any block
body:
## What does this mod do?
**This mod allows you to highlight blocks with different colors and 
display modes both in the singleplayer and on the server for various uses such as traps.**
## How to use it?
**You can select the block you are looking at by pressing "alt" or the button selected in the settings.Also you can choose color by pressing "[" and "]" or through the menu, which you can open by pressing "J"**
